notes: This data lists events with magnitude 2.5+ which have been located by the USGS and contributing agencies within the last day and last week.  To see these events in an interactive map, see the [USGS map](https://earthquake.usgs.gov/earthquakes/map/?extent=32.00808,23.99414&extent=44.2924,47.59277).  For more information, see the [USGS site](https://www.usgs.gov/programs/earthquake-hazards/earthquakes).
